name: mdh-compound-must-should-search
summary: Multi-field Atlas Search: boosted must clauses, optional should clauses, filter constraint.
notes: must = required boosted; should = optional ranking lift; filter = non-scoring constraint. This fragment is the query half of a MatchConfig only — it writes nothing until you add the mapping/result_actions block that lands the matched row on your schema fields, which is why produces is empty.
